LanguageData.LP_FaerunColony.label: Faerûn pioneer league
LanguageData.LP_FaerunColony.description: A pioneer league that crossed from the continent of Faerûn: humans, dwarves, elves and half-orcs clearing this strange land together. They defend themselves with sword and longbow, and paladins and clerics keep order.\n\nThe league's leaders will trade with any neighbor that follows the rules. But they hate undead and mind flayers: if the colony has a lich or mind flayer, the league will distance itself, and zealots in the church may even come witch-hunting against the leaders' wishes.
LanguageData.LP_FaerunColony.ideoDescription: Justice, mutual aid and vigilance against the undead. Pioneers believe the gods watch over every newly cleared field.
LanguageData.LP_FaerunHostile.label: Thayan expedition
LanguageData.LP_FaerunHostile.description: The Red Wizards of Thay cross the sea with undead, sigil trolls and hired orcs and minotaurs to build a new magical empire on this land.\n\nThe Red Wizards are the brains of the expedition: when a wizard falls, the skeletons bound to them crumble on the spot, sigil trolls go berserk and the orcs scatter. The expedition isn't a born enemy, but it's hard to please; the Red Wizards are especially interested in liches.
LanguageData.LP_FaerunHostile.ideoDescription: Power belongs to those who master magic. Everyone else was born to obey.
LanguageData.LP_EmberClan.label: ember clan
LanguageData.LP_EmberClan.description: A forge clan ruled by fire giants. A few fire giants sit by the furnaces giving orders, while captured humans and half-orcs in iron armor fight and mine for them.\n\nThe ember clan is cold toward outsiders but respects colonies of fellow fire giants; they hate trolls and are old enemies of the Thayan expedition. When the fire giants fall, the slave soldiers drop their weapons and run.
LanguageData.LP_EmberClan.ideoDescription: Fire forges the strong and melts the weak. The weak are only fit to hold the hammer for the strong.
LanguageData.LP_IllithidColony.label: Underdark colony
LanguageData.LP_IllithidColony.description: A mind flayer colony that crawled up from the depths of the Underdark. A few mind flayers psionically dominate a crowd of captured humans, dwarves, elves and half-orcs, sending them charging like puppets.\n\nThe colony negotiates with no one. They often dig up from below and emerge in the middle of a settlement. Kill or down the mind flayers and the dominated thralls wake up and collapse, and can be brought back.
LanguageData.LP_IllithidColony.ideoDescription: All minds will eventually flow into the master brain.
LanguageData.LP_BlackNetwork.label: Black Network
LanguageData.LP_BlackNetwork.description: A smuggling network with no bases and no banners. Black Network merchants occasionally show up at the colony gate selling slaves, poisons and goods of dubious origin, and buying organs, troll blood and mind flayer parts; the price always favors them.
LanguageData.LP_Zealots.label: witch-hunting zealots
LanguageData.LP_Zealots.description: Zealots in the church of Faerûn's pioneer league. Against the wishes of the league's leaders, they organize on their own to hunt liches and mind flayers. Killing them does not affect your relations with the league.
LanguageData.LP_Zealots.deityPresets.0.nameType.name: Tyr
LanguageData.LP_Zealots.deityPresets.1.nameType.name: Lathander
LanguageData.LP_Zealots.ideoDescription: The undead must be burned to ash.
